//: Phoenix's own connector packages that are in the catalog but do not come with Phoenix (docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 7, 'What comes with Phoenix': installed by those who want them). bin/serve.sh packs and uploads each, as the catalog's admin, to a development catalog; a release catalog gets them the same way (upload --phoenix). Their account types come from their packages' catalog.json. The pre-installed ones are in apps/marketplace/service/etc/palm/marketplace/preinstalled.json.
